---
name: grill-with-docs
description: Use when answering or clarifying a plan from supplied documents and current repository evidence.
---

# Clarify with documents

Read the referenced documents and relevant code. Cite the exact file or section. Separate requirements, planned design and tested implementation.

Answer clear questions directly. Use [grilling](../grilling/SKILL.md) only when material product decisions remain and [domain-modeling](../domain-modeling/SKILL.md) when terms or ownership are unclear. Ask only for missing consequential decisions and keep investigating while waiting. Do not rewrite the baseline spec without authorisation.
